hero.title: For Business
hero.subtitle: Coffi Points & Nomad Contextual Credits
hero.description: The new loyalty economy for work-friendly spaces

introduction.text: Coffi is building a living and decentralized network where every work-friendly space —café, coworking, rooftop, library, hotel— becomes an active node within the remote work ecosystem.
introduction.highlight: Nomad Contextual Credits are the contribution currency within that network.
introduction.description: A simple, human and powerful way to connect user interests and spaces in the same value cycle.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.description: Spaces compete every day with hundreds of options:

challenges.attract: How to attract users who really come to work or study?
challenges.retain: How to retain them without investing in expensive infrastructure?
challenges.standout: How to stand out in a saturated market?
challenges.understand: How to understand who they are, how they behave and what they seek?
challenges.community: How to build community without depending on social networks or daily content?

problem.userChallenges: On the other hand, users don't have real incentives to contribute:

userPoints.noReward: They gain nothing by updating the environment.
userPoints.noIncentive: They feel no reward for discovering new spaces.
userPoints.noSystem: There is no system that values their contribution to the ecosystem.

conclusion.spaces: Spaces want to understand and retain them.

solution.title: The Solution: Nomad Contextual Credits
solution.explanation: The Nomad Contextual Credits —represented by Coffi Points— allow users and spaces to participate in a shared economy where both win.

forUsers.title: For users
forUsers.description: Credits are earned every time they update the real context of a space or discover a new one. They become rewards, discounts and exclusive experiences.

forSpaces.title: For spaces
benefits: A community that returns because they feel they contribute and receive

solution.ecosystem: An ecosystem where everyone contributes, everyone wins and everyone prospers.

qr.title: The space's QR code
qr.description: Each space receives a personalized QR to place where payment or delivery is made. The user scans it and Coffi automatically opens the space's redemption screen.

choice.title: Benefit choice
choice.description: If the user has an account, they will see the discount options configured by the space:
choice.note: Each space defines its rules. Nomad and Wanderlust plans may have exclusive benefits.

transfer.title: Contextual point transfer
transfer.description: When the user chooses a discount:
process: Points are transferred to the space
The space applies the discount manually
Coffi records the entire transaction for space and user history

cycle.title: A perfect cycle
cycle.description: The user returns because there are incentives. The space gains loyalty and real data. Coffi keeps the ecosystem alive with contextual information.

userFlow.title: UX/UI Flow for Users
userFlow.description: Scan QR → See discounts → Select one → Confirm → Show screen to staff → Receive incentive → Keep contributing to the ecosystem.

loyalty.title: Real retention
loyalty.description: Users return because every action builds value. They have a real reason to choose your space over any other.

visibility.title: Visibility within Coffi
visibility.description: Your space appears in front of thousands of users looking for where to work or study. Each session positions you within the living map of remote work.

understanding.title: User understanding
understanding.description: Each month you will receive a Monthly Report with:
items: Profiles and professions of your users
Noise level, occupancy, energy and purpose
How many points your space received
understanding.conclusion: Real information to make better decisions.

community.title: Community building
community.description: Users feel part of the place. They contribute. They recommend it. They return with intention.

future.title: Future: Dashboard tools
future.description: As an early ally you will have access to:

impact.title: The Impact: Turn Your Space into a Preferred Destination
impact.description: Coffi is not a directory. Nor a review app. Nor a traditional points program.
impact.explanation: A living layer that unites users, spaces and cities.
impact.pioneer: The spaces that join now will be the pioneers of this ecosystem.
impact.quote: Here they recognize me. Here I belong. Here I return.

joinEcosystem.title: Join the Coffi Ecosystem
steps: Start receiving visits, points, data and community.
joinEcosystem.offer: The first spaces will have 3 months of Premium free when we launch the dashboard.
